gaps.valueSet: Hospitalization from 3 days before through 14 days after positive-influenza specimen collection
gaps.reason: the source states that this interval calculation is not operational and marks rule 1 inoperable; IAH-R1 is omitted

gaps.valueSet: Four-fold influenza antibody-titer rise between paired acute and convalescent specimens
gaps.reason: SEM_V1 cannot correlate paired specimens, compare titers, or enforce the 10-to-180-day collection interval; these alternatives are omitted from IAH-R2 and IAH-R3
the source reports no codes available; the ICD-10-CM branch is omitted from IAH-R5 while the influenza B SNOMED branch remains modeled
